limits: Group assignments prioritize an actionable issue and are not mutually exclusive causal truths.
Presence of the Gold label in a later clause does not prove the entire Rule Record correct.
No oracle label choice, clause reordering, Gold relabeling or retrospective score replacement.
Prompt length, distraction and internal reasoning causes remain untested hypotheses.
Test and dev errors have now informed diagnosis; neither is a fresh blind validation set for any future tuned prompt.
The previous six-check prompt was tested as a bundle; per-rule causal contribution is not established.
